name: Dead Stocks Report
query:
SELECT 
    item_code AS "Item Code", 
    warehouse AS "Warehouse", 
    actual_qty AS "Quantity", 
    valuation_rate AS "Valuation Rate", 
    (actual_qty * valuation_rate) AS "Total Value"
FROM 
    `tabBin`
WHERE 
    actual_qty > 0
    AND item_code NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT item_code 
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
        WHERE posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
    )
ORDER BY 
    actual_qty DESC;
